title: PeCoQ: A Dataset for Persian Complex Question Answering over Knowledge Graph
reasoning: The paper introduces a dataset for complex question answering over a general Persian knowledge graph (FarsBase, derived from Wikipedia). The focus is on the structural complexity of questions (e.g., multi-hop, temporal, ordinal constraints) and not on specific domains like religion, faith, or ethics. There is no component dedicated to evaluating or benchmarking these topics.
